name: Bera (Spain)
description: Square flag of rays of blue, light blue, white and olive yellow radiating from the centre, within a chequered border of the same colours, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Bera.
history: Municipal flag of Bera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: rays radiating from the centre and squares of the border
